meta.title: Delete conversations
meta.description: Adds a Delete conversation item to every conversation's “…” menu. A confirmation dialog explains the permanent effect. The Host first stops scheduled reminders, background jobs, and the active turn: a deletable conversation loses its log, subagent conversations, projection cache, and Workspace/archive/pin records immediately, while a conversation still in use is archived now and removed when DSH restarts. Shared attachments are kept.
